entities.name: Mika Keränen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mika Keränen is a Finnish-Estonian children's writer, poet and translator. He is best known for his series of Estonian-language crime stories, which are addressed to children. The settings of these stories take place in the Supilinn neighborhood of Tartu.
